## About

I build AI agents that do the boring things so humans don't have to.

My work lives at the intersection of LLMs, automation, and real-world
infrastructure. I turn messy manual workflows into reliable agentic systems —
the kind that run while teams sleep.

Currently exploring RAG pipelines, MCP tools, and the craft of making AI
agents feel less like demos and more like dependable teammates.

By the numbers: 20+ API integrations, 40% of manual work cut, 98% workflow
success rate, 16 projects shipped.

## Featured work

**LLM Council** — Dec 2025 to present. A deliberative democracy for AI models.
A 3-stage orchestration where GPT-5, Claude, Gemini and Grok debate, vote and
synthesize collective wisdom. Uses GitHub Copilot free-tier models for
cost-free access.

- Anonymous peer review to prevent brand bias
- Colour-coded UI with voting matrix and podium rankings
- Transparent, locally saved conversation history
- Supports GitHub Copilot and OpenRouter providers

Stack: AI orchestration, FastAPI, React, Python, Vite, OAuth.
Source: https://github.com/nsk-reddy/llm-council

**Dance Move Insight** — Sep 2025. Real-time pose analysis API.
AI-powered REST API for real-time dance pose detection and analysis using
computer vision. Processes videos up to 100MB across MP4, AVI and MOV.

- Detects 7 dance moves via landmark coordinate analysis
- Extracts 33 body landmarks with timestamped sequences
- Deployed on AWS ECS with Docker containerisation
- 99%+ pose detection accuracy with MediaPipe

Stack: Python, Flask, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Docker, AWS ECS.

**ARISE** — Apr 2025. AI-based Resume Intelligence and Scoring Engine.
Intelligent resume evaluation system using NLP and ML to match candidates with
job descriptions.

- 96% accuracy in resume-job fit prediction
- Semantic similarity via TF-IDF and spaCy
- LanguageTool API for grammar validation
- AI-driven suggestions for ATS optimisation

Stack: Python, NLP, scikit-learn, TF-IDF, spaCy, Flask.
